# Easy Suite (EasyAgent × EasyGateway)

> Go-powered, local-first personal AI infrastructure (MIT License). EasyAgent is a multi-platform AI coding assistant & agent workbench (macOS/Linux native desktop, Android, Web, TUI, Feishu, MCP, reusable Go SDK). EasyGateway is a lightweight (~18 MB RAM) unified LLM gateway supporting OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages APIs with capability-based routing and automatic fallback.

## Core Products

- **EasyAgent**: Personal AI coding assistant and agent workbench written in Go. Supports native desktop (MyGo), Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose), Web workspace, terminal TUI, Feishu bot integration, MCP (stdio / Streamable HTTP / SSE / OAuth), and a reusable Go SDK (`sdk/`).
- **EasyGateway**: Lightweight personal AI infrastructure gateway written in Go (~18 MB RAM, <1s startup). Unifies Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi, and EasyAgent behind one local or self-hosted endpoint (`:4001`), with 3-protocol compatibility, multi-tier fallback, circuit breaking, per-key token quotas, EasyCode channel auth, shared skills (`~/.agents/skills`), and cross-client memory.

## Quick Install

- EasyAgent CLI (macOS / Linux): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nightgopher/easyagent/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
- EasyGateway (macOS / Linux): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nightgopher/easygateway/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
- Downloads (DMG, .deb, Android APK): https://nightgopher.github.io/easy-suite/download/

- [Skills Market](https://nightgopher.github.io/easy-suite/skills/): Browse and install Agent skills (`~/.agents/skills`)
